definitions.text_mt: Kamra ta' fuq f'dar tradizzjonali tal-irħula.

usage_examples.text_mt: In-nannu kien jorqod fl-għorfa u kien jinżel l-isfel kull filgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: Grandfather used to sleep in the upper room and would come downstairs every morning.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għorfa kienet tintuża biex tinħażen il-qamħ u prodotti oħra.
usage_examples.text_en: The upper room was used to store grain and other produce.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġabar il-ġebel kollu f'għorma waħda fil-genb tar-raba.
usage_examples.text_en: He gathered all the stones into one heap at the edge of the field.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għorma tar-ramel kibret wara l-maltemp.
usage_examples.text_en: The sand dune grew after the storm.

definitions.text_en: a small hut used to store products
definitions.text_mt: Għarix żgħir fejn jinħażnu l-prodotti tar-raba.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġellieda nsterbu fl-għorna matul il-gwerra.
usage_examples.text_en: The fighters hid in the cave during the war.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għorna kienet mimlija patata u basla.
usage_examples.text_en: The small hut was full of potatoes and onions.

definitions.text_mt: Għaddi idejk fuq xi ħaġa b'moviment 'il quddiem u lura b'pressioni.
Għorok u agħfas il-muskoli biex ittaffi t-tensjoni.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għorok għajnejh għax kien għajjien wara ġurnata twila.
usage_examples.text_en: He rubbed his eyes because he was tired after a long day.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fisjoterapista għorok dahri biex itaffi l-uġigħ.
usage_examples.text_en: The physiotherapist massaged my back to relieve the pain.

usage_examples.text_mt: Kien għors kbir fl-irħula ta' żmien ilu.
usage_examples.text_en: It was a big wedding in the villages of long ago.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għors dam il-ġimgħa kollha bil-festi u ż-żfin.
usage_examples.text_en: The celebration lasted the whole week with feasts and dancing.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta li ż-żerriegħa tagħha tintuża biex tagħti lewn isfar jew aħmar lill-ikel.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għosfor jintuża minn żminijiet antiki bieb jagħti l-kulur lill-ħwejjeġ.
usage_examples.text_en: Safflower has been used since ancient times to dye clothes.

usage_examples.text_mt: Iż-żejt ta' l-għosfor huwa tajjeb għas-saħħa tal-qalb.
usage_examples.text_en: Safflower oil is good for heart health.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kulur ta' din il-fjura huwa għosfri u jfakkar fil-ħarifa.
usage_examples.text_en: The colour of this flower is saffron-like and reminds one of autumn.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għotba ġietu wara l-inċident tal-karozza.
usage_examples.text_en: The crippling came to him after the car accident.

definitions.text_mt: Tilef il-ħila li timxi jew tiċċaqlaq minħabba diżabilità fiżika.

definitions.text_en: to set (a sun, a moon, etc…)
definitions.text_mt: Għarab fix-xemx jew fil-qamar 'l isfel mill-orizzont.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għotob wara li waqa' mis-siġra u ma setax jerġa' jimxi.
usage_examples.text_en: He became crippled after falling from the tree and could not walk again.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ix-xemx għotbet wara l-baħar fil-għaxija.
usage_examples.text_en: The sun set behind the sea in the evening.

definitions.text_mt: Tfixkel waqt li timxi u kważi taqa'.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għotor fuq ġebla u waqa' mal-art.
usage_examples.text_en: He stumbled on a stone and fell to the ground.

usage_examples.text_mt: Oqgħod attent li ma togħtorx fit-triq mimlija ġebel.
usage_examples.text_en: Be careful not to stumble on the stony road.

definitions.text_en: to break out in laughter or (less often) tears
definitions.text_mt: Faqa' għad-daħk jew għall-biki bla kontroll.
Ħadt gost u ferħ kbir b'xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għoxa meta ra d-demm u waqa' mal-art.
usage_examples.text_en: He fainted when he saw the blood and fell to the ground.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għoxa għad-daħk meta sema' l-istorja umoristika.
usage_examples.text_en: He broke out in laughter when he heard the funny story.

definitions.text_mt: Ħaxix jew pjanti żgħar li jikbru mal-art.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-baqar jieklu l-għoxb fir-raba' tar-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.text_en: The cows eat the grass in the spring fields.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għoxb kien niexef wara s-sajf twil.
usage_examples.text_en: The grass was dry after the long summer.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għoxrin student attendew il-klassi llum.
usage_examples.text_en: Twenty students attended the class today.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għandu għoxrin sena u għadu qed jistudja.
usage_examples.text_en: He is twenty years old and still studying.

definitions.text_mt: Kliem jew ħlewwa li jsaħħaħ espressjoni jew sentiment negattiv.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għasfur bena għoxx sabiħ fis-siġra tal-ġnien.
usage_examples.text_en: The bird built a beautiful nest in the garden tree.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tibżax minnu — huwa għoxx u ma jgħidlek xejn.
usage_examples.text_en: Don't be afraid of him — he is a wimp and won't do anything to you.

definitions.text_mt: Ġab sodisfazzjon jew pjaċir lil xi ħadd.

definitions.text_en: to appeal to (often expresses English like)

usage_examples.text_mt: Din l-idea għoġbitni ħafna u naqbel magħha.
usage_examples.text_en: I really liked this idea and agree with it.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ktieb għoġob lil kulħadd fil-klassi.
usage_examples.text_en: The book pleased everyone in the class.

definitions.text_mt: Fergħun ta' baqra jew ta' gendus.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għoġol għadu żgħir u jredda' minn ommu.
usage_examples.text_en: The calf is still small and suckling from its mother.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bidwi xtara għoġol ġdid biex irabbih għall-ħalib.
usage_examples.text_en: The farmer bought a new calf to raise for milk.

definitions.text_mt: Annimal tal-baħar bil-pil, b'denbu qasir u x-xwiek, li jgħix kemm fl-ilma kif ukoll fuq l-art.

usage_examples.text_mt: Rajna għoġol il-baħar jistrieħ fuq il-blata fix-xemx.
usage_examples.text_en: We saw a seal resting on the rock in the sun.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għoġol il-baħar għaddas fil-baħar meta resaqna lejh.
usage_examples.text_en: The seal dived into the sea when we approached it.

definitions.text_mt: Imħabba u kura ġentili lejn xi ħadd.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tifel kiber bl-għożża ta' ommu u missieru.
usage_examples.text_en: The child grew up with the cherishing of his mother and father.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għożża li turihom turi kemm tħobbhom.
usage_examples.text_en: The affectionate care you show them shows how much you love them.

definitions.text_mt: Kull oġġett jew għodda magħmula mill-injam.

usage_examples.text_mt: Qasam l-għuda b'mannara u qabad in-nar.
usage_examples.text_en: He split the piece of wood with an axe and lit the fire.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għuda tas-salib hija mqaddsa għall-Insara.
usage_examples.text_en: The wood of the cross is sacred to Christians.

definitions.text_mt: Ħlejqa tal-ħrejjef Għarab li tiekol il-bnedmin u tidher fid-deżert.

usage_examples.text_mt: Fl-istejjer antiki, l-għul kien jgħix fid-deżert u jiekol lil min jintilef.
usage_examples.text_en: In ancient stories, the ghoul used to live in the desert and eat those who got lost.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għul jissemma' f'ħafna rakkonti folkloristiċi.
usage_examples.text_en: The ghoul is mentioned in many folkloric tales.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għula kienet tħobb tqarraq lit-tfal fl-istejjer.
usage_examples.text_en: The female ghoul used to trick children in the stories.

usage_examples.text_mt: Kemmuna hija gżejra bejn Malta u Għawdex.
usage_examples.text_en: Comino is a small island between Malta and Gozo.

usage_examples.text_mt: Iż-żewġ gżejriet ta' San Pawl jinsabu qrib il-baħar.
usage_examples.text_en: The two small islands of St Paul are located near the sea.

definitions.text_mt: Biċċa art imdawra bl-ilma minn kull naħa.

usage_examples.text_mt: Malta hija gżira fil-baħar Mediterran.
usage_examples.text_en: Malta is an island in the Mediterranean Sea.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għawdex hija t-tieni l-ikbar gżira fl-arċipelagu Malti.
usage_examples.text_en: Gozo is the second largest island in the Maltese archipelago.

definitions.text_en: to govern, to rule by law
definitions.text_mt: Tmexxi stat jew pajjiż skont il-liġijiet u r-regoli.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Prim Ministru ggverna l-pajjiż għal ħames snin.
usage_examples.text_en: The Prime Minister governed the country for five years.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jiggverna lill-impjegati tiegħu b'idejn iebsa.
usage_examples.text_en: He governs his employees with a firm hand.

definitions.text_mt: Kostellazzjoni ta' stilel li tixbaħ lill-għakreb.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Għaqreb jidher fid-dbielet tas-sema fis-swiegħed tas-sajf.
usage_examples.text_en: Scorpius can be seen in the southern sky on summer nights.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tweldet taħt is-sinjal tal-Għaqreb u tħobb l-astroloġija.
usage_examples.text_en: She was born under the sign of Scorpio and loves astrology.
